summary: Nora's position in a room now keeps what she found on a turn and has not yet shared, knows how old it is, and is never thrown away by a second model's judgement.
details: The post-turn fold is one model call: the grounding verdict that ran beside it, and the re-derivations it triggered, are removed. A re-derivation rewrote the position without showing the model the previous one, so each one dropped the threads she was holding.

The fold is shown tool results up to 4000 characters instead of 600, and is told they survive only through what it writes, so a search that found more than she sent can leave its findings in the position.
The previous position is shown with how long ago it was written, and the fold writes dates instead of words like today or tomorrow, so a stale clause can be recognised and dropped.
The turn's steps are shown as they are: private reasoning appears, marked, only when the model produced any.
limitations: The [standing] rebuild_after_folds key is removed; a config that still sets it refuses to start.
The turn_verdict table and standing.consumed_verdict_tag column are left in place with no writer.
